an5.255:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcannaṃ bhikkhave macchariyānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
an5.255:1.4: kulamacchariyassa …pe… lābhamacchariyassa …pe… vaṇṇamacchariyassa …pe… dhammamacchariyassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.
an5.255:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ macchariyānaṃ pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
